articles.title: 2026 CLUB AWARDS | Celebrating Excellence, Service, and Commitment: RCM Honors Outstanding Members for Rotary Year 2025–2026

body.text: AS Rotary Year 2025–2026 comes to a close, the Rotary Club of Manila once again reaffirmed its tradition of recognizing excellence, dedication, and service through its annual Club Awards Program. More than a ceremony of recognition, the awards serve as a celebration of the values that have sustained Asia’s first Rotary club for over a century — commitment, fellowship, leadership, loyalty, and Service Above Self.

The Club Awards recognize members whose actions throughout the year have strengthened the organization and advanced its mission of making a meaningful difference in the lives of others. From exemplary participation in club activities to decades of unwavering commitment, the honorees represent the very best of what it means to be a Manila Rotarian.

One of the highlights of the awards program was the presentation of the Best Attendance Awards, honoring members who consistently demonstrated their dedication by actively participating in weekly membership meetings, board meetings, service projects, fellowship activities, and other club functions throughout the Rotary year. While attendance may appear to be a simple measure, it reflects a deeper commitment to the life of the club. Strong participation fosters fellowship, strengthens camaraderie, and ensures that members remain engaged in the planning and execution of meaningful service initiatives.

The Club also paid tribute to members whose long-standing dedication has helped preserve the traditions and institutional memory of the organization through the Legacy and Loyalty Awards. These recognitions were bestowed upon Rotarians who have devoted significant portions of their lives to the Rotary Club of Manila, with milestones ranging from fifteen to forty-five years of membership.

Such longevity is a remarkable achievement in itself. Beyond the years, however, these awards recognize the countless hours devoted to service projects, mentorship, leadership, fundraising, community development, and club administration. These Rotarians have witnessed the club's evolution through changing times while remaining steadfast in their commitment to Rotary’s ideals. Their dedication has helped shape generations of leaders and ensured that the Rotary Club of Manila remains a vibrant and relevant institution more than a century after its founding.

Equally inspiring was the presentation of the Rising Manila Rotarian Awards, which recognize newer members who have quickly distinguished themselves through active participation, leadership potential, initiative, and a strong commitment to Rotary values. These awardees represent the next generation of leaders who will carry forward the proud traditions of the club while bringing fresh ideas, new energy, and innovative approaches to service.
2026 Club Awards

The recognition of emerging leaders reflects the Club’s commitment to continuity and succession. By encouraging newer members to become actively involved early in their Rotary journey, the Rotary Club of Manila ensures that its legacy of service will continue to flourish for generations to come.

Taken together, the various awards highlight the diverse ways in which members contribute to the success of the organization. Some lead through decades of faithful service. Others contribute through consistent participation and engagement. Still others distinguish themselves through enthusiasm, initiative, and emerging leadership. Each contribution, regardless of form, plays a vital role in strengthening the Club and expanding its impact on the communities it serves.

The annual Club Awards also serve as a reminder that Rotary is ultimately a people-centered organization. Projects may define the Club’s public impact, but it is the dedication, generosity, and commitment of its members that make those projects possible.

Behind every successful initiative, every community service project, every scholarship program, and every humanitarian effort are Rotarians who willingly give their time, talents, and resources in pursuit of a greater purpose.

As the Rotary Club of Manila prepares to embark on a new Rotary year, the accomplishments celebrated through the 2025–2026 Club Awards provide both inspiration and motivation. The awardees embody the values that have guided the Club for more than a century and serve as examples for future generations of Manila Rotarians.

Their stories remind us that Rotary’s enduring strength lies not only in its history but in the continued commitment of its members to live out the ideal of Service Above Self. Through their dedication, leadership, and unwavering spirit of fellowship, they help ensure that the Rotary Club of Manila remains a force for good, creating lasting impact in the Philippines and beyond.
Honoring the Faces of Service

This year's Club Awardees represent the very best of the Rotary Club of Manila — individuals whose dedication, leadership, loyalty, and commitment to Service Above Self have helped strengthen the Club and advance its mission throughout Rotary Year 2025–2026.

Among them are members whose exemplary attendance reflects an unwavering commitment to fellowship and engagement; veteran Rotarians whose decades of faithful service have preserved and enriched the Club's proud legacy; and emerging leaders whose enthusiasm, initiative, and active participation embody the future of Asia's first Rotary club.

Collectively, these awardees remind us that Rotary's greatest asset is not its history, projects, or achievements, but the men and women who willingly devote their time, talents, and resources to serving others. Through their example, they inspire fellow Rotarians to continue building a stronger Club and a more compassionate society.
The Rotary Club of Manila proudly recognizes these outstanding members whose contributions have made a lasting impact on the Club and the communities it serves.
Best Attendance Award
The Best Attendance Award recognizes Rotarians whose consistent presence and active participation throughout the Rotary year exemplify commitment, discipline, and dedication to the life of the Club.

More than a measure of attendance, this award honors members who have demonstrated their unwavering support for the Rotary Club of Manila through regular engagement in meetings, fellowship activities, service projects, and club initiatives.
Their steadfast participation strengthens the bonds of fellowship, fosters continuity in leadership, and serves as an inspiring example of commitment to Service Above Self.

Recognizing significant membership milestones, this award celebrates individuals who have faithfully upheld Rotary’s ideals across decades of fellowship, leadership, and service.

Their steadfast devotion, institutional memory, and unwavering support have preserved the Club’s proud heritage while inspiring future generations of Manila Rotarians to continue the tradition of Service Above Self.

Though relatively early in their Rotary journey, these awardees have already demonstrated leadership potential, initiative, and a genuine commitment to Rotary’s ideals of fellowship and service.

Their energy, fresh perspectives, and willingness to go beyond expectations have made them exemplary STAR Rotarians and promising future leaders of the Rotary Club of Manila. Through their dedication and passion for Service Above Self, they embody the bright future of Asia’s first Rotary club.

The Presidential Citation Award is bestowed upon Rotarians and/or Rotaractors who have rendered exceptional service and made significant contributions to the success of the Club during the Rotary year.
Selected by the President, this special recognition honors individuals whose dedication, leadership, initiative, and unwavering support have gone above and beyond the ordinary call of duty.

Through their outstanding commitment to the Club’s programs, projects, and objectives, these awardees have played an invaluable role in advancing the mission of the Rotary Club of Manila and exemplifying the true spirit of Service Above Self.

Presidential Award

This recognition is reserved for individuals who have consistently demonstrated excellence, gone beyond expectations, and played a vital role in advancing the Club’s mission, programs, and strategic objectives.
Through their exemplary commitment, selfless service, and unwavering support, these awardees embody the finest traditions of Rotary and the enduring spirit of Service Above Self.

As Chairman of the Rotary Information Committee, Obet played a pivotal role in strengthening Rotary education within the Club by ensuring that new members were effectively oriented to the ideals, traditions, and mission of Rotary. Through his dedication to mentoring and member development, he helped cultivate a deeper understanding of Rotary values and contributed significantly to building a stronger foundation for the future of the Rotary Club of Manila. His commitment to educating and inspiring fellow Rotarians has left a lasting impact on the Club and its membership.

As a Past President of the Rotary Club of Manila, Ebot served as a trusted mentor and adviser whose wisdom, experience, and steadfast support provided invaluable guidance to the Club’s leadership. Through his thoughtful counsel, encouragement, and leadership insights, he helped foster confidence and clarity in decision-making, enabling the Club to pursue its projects and initiatives with greater purpose and direction. His enduring commitment to mentoring future leaders reflects the spirit of fellowship and service that continues to strengthen the Rotary Club of Manila.

As a Past President of the Rotary Club of Manila, Ebot served as a trusted mentor and adviser whose wisdom, experience, and steadfast support provided invaluable guidance to the Club’s leadership. Through his thoughtful counsel, encouragement, and leadership insights, he helped foster confidence and clarity in decision-making, enabling the Club to pursue its projects and initiatives with greater purpose and direction. His enduring commitment to mentoring future leaders reflects the spirit of fellowship and service that continues to strengthen the Rotary Club of Manila.

As Chairman of the Classification Committee, Bren provided diligent stewardship in safeguarding one of Rotary’s most important membership traditions. Through his careful evaluation and assignment of classifications for prospective and incoming members, he helped maintain the diversity, professional excellence, and integrity that distinguish the Rotary Club of Manila. His commitment to upholding Rotary standards has contributed significantly to preserving the Club’s strong and balanced membership foundation

As Chairman of the Teacher Training Program and Website Design and Development Committee, Nico provided visionary leadership in advancing both educational and digital initiatives of the Rotary Club of Manila. Through his efforts in teacher development, he helped empower educators and promote professional growth, while his work in enhancing the Club’s website strengthened its online presence, communication, and accessibility. His creativity, innovation, and commitment to service contributed significantly to expanding the Club’s impact and engagement both within and beyond the Rotary community.

As Chairman of the Program Committee, Del played a vital role in enhancing the quality and relevance of the Rotary Club of Manila’s weekly membership meetings through the development of engaging and meaningful programs. His thoughtful leadership and dedication ensured that members were exposed to insightful discussions, inspiring speakers, and timely topics that enriched fellowship and promoted learning. Through his commitment to excellence, he contributed significantly to the success, substance, and prestige of the Club’s regular gatherings.

As Chairman of the Board of Judges of the TOWER Awards and an active member of both the ARAL (Advancing Resources for Accessible Learning) Program Committee and the Rotary Information Committee, Romy provided invaluable leadership, sound judgment, and dedicated service to several of the Club’s flagship initiatives. Through his stewardship of the TOWER Awards, he helped uphold the integrity and prestige of a program that honors the dignity of labor, while his contributions to educational and Rotary information initiatives advanced the Club’s commitment to literacy, learning, and member development. His quiet leadership and unwavering commitment to excellence have left a meaningful impact on the Rotary Club of Manila and the communities it serves.

As Chairman of the Membership Committee, Fausto played a critical role in safeguarding the standards, integrity, and traditions of the Rotary Club of Manila through the careful evaluation and screening of prospective members. His sound judgment, fairness, and commitment to excellence helped ensure that the Club continued to attract individuals of character, leadership, and a genuine dedication to service. Through his stewardship, he contributed significantly to maintaining the quality and distinction of membership in Asia’s first Rotary club.

As Chairman of the Rotary Club of Manila’s Medical Mission, Dan demonstrated outstanding leadership and compassion in bringing essential healthcare services to underserved communities. Through his effective coordination of volunteers, partners, and resources, he helped ensure the successful planning and implementation of the medical mission, enabling the Club to address critical health needs and improve the well-being of countless beneficiaries. His dedication to humanitarian service exemplifies Rotary’s commitment to making a meaningful difference in the lives of others.

Through his generous support and hands-on assistance in providing venues for the Rotary Club of Manila’s special meetings, assemblies, and major events, Bernd played an important role in fostering fellowship and ensuring the success of many significant Club gatherings. His attention to detail, spirit of cooperation, and commitment to excellence helped create memorable and dignified occasions that strengthened camaraderie among members and advanced the Club’s mission of service

As Chairman of the Fellowship Committee and lead organizer of both the 3rd RCM Cup Golf Tournament and the Oktoberfest Celebration, Nico played a key role in strengthening fellowship and camaraderie within the Rotary Club of Manila. Through his enthusiasm, creativity, and effective leadership, he successfully organized memorable events that fostered friendship, unity, and meaningful engagement among members. His dedication and attention to detail contributed significantly to the success of these flagship Club activities and helped enrich the Rotary experience for Manila Rotarians.

As Chairman of the Sports Committee, Nagi demonstrated outstanding dedication in promoting fellowship, wellness, and camaraderie among members through a variety of sporting activities and events. By creating opportunities for Manila Rotarians to connect beyond regular meetings, he helped strengthen friendships, encourage active participation, and foster a spirit of unity and healthy competition within the Club. His enthusiasm and commitment contributed meaningfully to enriching the overall Rotary experience for members.

As a Member of the Board of Directors of the Rotary Club of Manila, Hans demonstrated exemplary leadership and dedication in helping guide the Club’s policies, programs, and strategic direction. His faithful service reflected a deep commitment to Rotary ideals and helped uphold the Club’s enduring legacy of excellence, fellowship, and Service Above Self.

As Treasurer of the Rotary Club of Manila, PJ demonstrated exceptional diligence, integrity, and financial stewardship in managing the Club’s resources and safeguarding its financial stability. Through his prudent oversight, professionalism, and commitment to accountability, he helped ensure the effective support of the Club’s programs, projects, and humanitarian initiatives. His dedicated service and sound financial management contributed significantly to the continued success and sustainability of the Rotary Club of Manila.

As Assistant Treasurer and Chairman of the RCM CUP Committee, Karlo rendered dedicated service in both the financial and fellowship activities of the Rotary Club of Manila. Through his diligence and professionalism, he provided valuable support in the management of the Club’s financial affairs while demonstrating effective leadership in the successful organization of the RCM CUP. His efforts helped strengthen fellowship, camaraderie, and engagement among members, contributing meaningfully to the Club’s mission and overall success during the Rotary year.

As the Sergeant-at-Arms of the Rotary Club of Manila, Dave provided dedicated leadership and valuable guidance in shaping the Club’s policies, priorities, and service initiatives. Through his active participation, thoughtful counsel, and steadfast commitment, he helped advance the Club’s programs and humanitarian efforts while strengthening its culture of excellence, fellowship, and Service Above Self. His contributions played an important role in supporting the Club’s mission and preserving its proud legacy of impactful service.

Through his principled leadership and steadfast commitment to the Rotary Club of Manila and the Rotary Club of Manila Foundation, Inc. As Assistant Internal Auditor, he exercised careful judgment and diligence in reviewing processes, evaluating risks, and ensuring adherence to established standards. His thoughtful counsel, integrity, and unwavering sense of responsibility contributed significantly to strengthening the Foundation and advancing the Club’s mission of service.

As Club Assistant Secretary, Paco provided dedicated and dependable support in the administration and day-to-day operations of the Rotary Club of Manila. Through his diligence, professionalism, and attention to detail, he helped ensure the smooth coordination of Club activities, effective communication among members, and the successful implementation of programs and initiatives. His steadfast commitment and behind-the-scenes contributions played an important role in strengthening the Club’s operations and advancing its mission of service.

As Board Legal Adviser and Co-Chair of both the Program Committee and the Journalism Awards Committee, Charlie rendered distinguished service to the Rotary Club of Manila through his legal expertise, sound judgment, and dedicated leadership. His guidance on governance matters helped ensure clarity and adherence to the Club’s Constitution and By-Laws, while his active involvement in organizing weekly membership meetings and the Journalism Awards contributed significantly to the success and quality of these important Club activities. Through his professionalism, reliability, and commitment to service, he played a vital role in advancing the Club’s mission and strengthening its tradition of excellence.
Presidential Award with Distinction

The Presidential Award with Distinction is one of the highest honors conferred by the Club President upon Rotarians whose extraordinary leadership, exceptional service, and enduring contributions have had a profound impact on the Rotary Club of Manila.

This distinguished recognition is reserved for individuals who have consistently gone beyond expectations, demonstrating unwavering commitment, exemplary character, and a steadfast dedication to advancing the Club’s mission, strengthening its legacy, and exemplifying the highest ideals of Rotary.

Through his visionary leadership and unwavering commitment to peace building, Teddy developed and championed the LEAP (Leaders Excelling in ADR and Peacebuilding) Awards, transforming it into one of the Rotary Club of Manila’s flagship and award winning programs. By promoting dialogue, understanding, and alternative dispute resolution, he helped advance a culture of peace and harmony within communities. His innovation, dedication, and enduring contribution have strengthened the Club’s impact and reinforced Rotary’s role as a catalyst for positive social change.

Through his exceptional dedication and multifaceted service to the Rotary Club of Manila, Nonie played a pivotal role in the administration, fellowship, recognition programs, and overall success of the Club during the Rotary year. As Club Secretary, he ensured the efficient and orderly management of Club affairs, while his leadership in the Fellowship and Club Awards Committees helped strengthen member engagement and celebrate excellence within the organization. His active participation in numerous projects and initiatives, coupled with his reliability, professionalism, and unwavering commitment to service, contributed significantly to the vitality, effectiveness, and continued success of the Rotary Club of Manila.

Through his wisdom, experience, and unwavering commitment to Rotary, Jackie served as a trusted mentor and guiding presence to the leadership of the Rotary Club of Manila. As a Past District Governor, his thoughtful counsel, steady support, and exemplary leadership provided valuable direction in advancing the Club’s mission and strengthening its enduring legacy. His dedication to mentoring future leaders and fostering Rotary excellence has left a lasting and meaningful impact on the Club and its members.
Service Award

The Service Award is presented to Rotarians whose dedication, commitment, and active involvement have significantly contributed to the success of the Rotary Club of Manila and its mission of Service Above Self.

This recognition honors individuals who have generously shared their time, talents, and resources in support of the Club’s programs, projects, and initiatives, helping create meaningful and lasting impact in the communities it serves. Through their selfless service and unwavering commitment, they exemplify the true spirit of Rotary.

As Chairman of both the Music Committee and Sunshine Committee, Oca enriched the Rotary Club of Manila through his dedication to fostering fellowship, camaraderie, and Club spirit. Through music, he brought members together in celebration and friendship, while his stewardship of memorial and remembrance programs honored the lives and contributions of departed Rotarians with dignity and respect. His compassion, enthusiasm, and commitment to preserving the Club’s traditions helped strengthen the bonds that unite Manila Rotarians across generations.

Through his visionary leadership and unwavering commitment to excellence, Susing elevated the TOWER Awards as one of the Rotary Club of Manila’s most distinguished and impactful signature programs. By championing the recognition of outstanding Filipino workers and promoting the dignity of labor, he helped ensure the continued relevance, prestige, and success of the awards. His dedication, organizational leadership, and passion for honoring exemplary service have strengthened the enduring legacy of the TOWER Awards and its contribution to nation building.

Dean Amading served with distinction as Chairman of the Journalism Awards Committee and as a member of the TOWER Awards Committee and Program Committee of the Rotary Club of Manila. Through his leadership, integrity, and commitment to excellence, he helped preserve the credibility and prestige of the Journalism Awards as a meaningful recognition of journalistic integrity, truth-telling, and the vital role of the press in nation-building. He likewise made significant contributions to the success of the Club’s various flagship programs and initiatives, earning the Rotary Club of Manila’s Presidential Award of Distinction for his dedicated and faithful service.

Junjie was recognized for his selfless generosity and exemplary service to the Rotary Club of Manila through the donation of a prominent EDSA billboard that helped promote Rotary’s ideals and the Four-Way Test to a broader audience. By providing a highly visible platform for Rotary’s message of integrity, truth, fairness, goodwill, and mutual benefit, he contributed significantly to advancing civic consciousness and reinforcing the ethical values that guide Rotarians in their service to society. In recognition of his unwavering support of Rotary ideals, he was awarded a Special Presidential Citation by the Rotary Club of Manila.

Raf demonstrated exemplary leadership and dedicated service in organizing the Rotary Club of Manila’s tree planting activity and community economic development project with the Dumagat Tribe. Through his initiative, compassion, and commitment to sustainable development, he advanced environmental stewardship and community empowerment while fostering meaningful collaboration between the Club and the indigenous community. His efforts helped ensure that Rotary’s service initiatives were both inclusive and transformative, earning him the Rotary Club of Manila’s Presidential Award in recognition of his invaluable contributions and faithful service.

Dr. John rendered exemplary service and dedicated leadership in organizing the Rotary Club of Manila’s oral healthcare initiatives and in forging partnerships with various organizations to advance programs on oral hygiene and preventive dental care. Through his commitment to public health and community service, he helped promote oral health awareness, deliver essential dental services, and improve the well being of underserved communities. His leadership, professionalism, and unwavering dedication brought honor and distinction to the Rotary Club of Manila, earning him the Club’s Presidential Award in recognition of his invaluable contributions and faithful service.

Phil provided exemplary leadership and outstanding service in forging and sustaining a meaningful partnership between the Rotary Club of Manila and Hospicio de San Antonio. Through his initiative, dedication, and steadfast commitment, he helped implement impactful programs that enhanced the lives of vulnerable communities, including gift-giving activities, an art exhibit, and Project RIVER (Rotary Initiative for Vulnerability Elimination and Resilience), the Club’s flagship WASH initiative. In recognition of his invaluable contributions and faithful service, he was awarded the Rotary Club of Manila’s Presidential Award of Distinction.

Ray demonstrated exemplary leadership and outstanding service in establishing and strengthening a meaningful partnership between the Rotary Club of Manila and Hospicio de San Antonio. Through his initiative, dedication, and steadfast commitment, he helped implement impactful community programs, including gift-giving activities, an art exhibit, and Project RIVER (Rotary Initiative for Vulnerability Elimination and Resilience), the Club’s flagship WASH initiative. His efforts significantly advanced the Club’s humanitarian mission and service objectives, earning him the Rotary Club of Manila’s Presidential Award of Distinction in recognition of his invaluable contributions and faithful service.

Nick rendered dedicated and exemplary service to the Rotary Club of Manila as Chairman of the International Committee and as Internal Auditor. Through his commitment, diplomacy, and tireless efforts, he strengthened the bonds of friendship, goodwill, and cooperation between the Club and Rotary clubs around the world. As Internal Auditor, he provided prudent oversight, ensuring that processes were carefully reviewed, risks appropriately considered, and decisions guided by transparency, accountability, and adherence to established standards. In recognition of his faithful service and outstanding dedication, he was awarded the Rotary Club of Manila’s Presidential Award.
President's Citation of Appreciation

The President’s Citation of Appreciation is bestowed upon individuals and organizations whose generous support, meaningful contributions, and steadfast commitment have significantly advanced the mission, programs, and ideals of the Rotary Club of Manila.

Raffy was recognized for his unwavering support of the Rotary Club of Manila and his extraordinary generosity in advancing the Club’s mission of Service Above Self. Through his significant contribution of One Million Pesos (₱1,000,000) to the ARAL Program, a flagship educational initiative of the Club, he helped expand opportunities for learning and personal development while strengthening Rotary’s commitment to creating meaningful and lasting impact in the communities it serves. In grateful appreciation of his philanthropy and support, he was awarded the Rotary Club of Manila’s President’s Citation of Appreciation.
Presidential Tribute Award

The Presidential Tribute Award is bestowed upon individuals whose extraordinary dedication, exemplary leadership, and enduring contributions have left a profound and lasting impact on the Rotary Club of Manila, its members, and the communities it serves.

Through their unwavering commitment to the ideals of Service Above Self, they have inspired others, strengthened the Club’s mission, and helped advance Rotary’s legacy of meaningful service and ethical leadership.

Vince was honored with the Presidential Tribute Award in recognition of his invaluable service, steadfast mentorship, and unwavering support to the Rotary Club of Manila. As a Past District Governor, he generously shared his wisdom, experience, and sound counsel with the Club’s leadership, serving as a trusted adviser and guiding presence. His calm strength, discerning judgment, and enduring commitment have contributed significantly to advancing the Club’s mission and preserving its proud legacy, earning the deep gratitude and highest appreciation of the Rotary Club of Manila.

Rudy was honored with the Presidential Tribute Award in recognition of his invaluable service, steadfast mentorship, and unwavering support to the Rotary Club of Manila. As a Past District Governor, he generously shared his wisdom, experience, and sound counsel with the Club President, serving as a trusted mentor and quiet yet influential guiding presence. His calm leadership, discerning advice, and loyal support played a significant role in advancing the Club’s mission and strengthening its enduring legacy. Through his exemplary dedication and faithful service, he earned the profound gratitude and highest esteem of the Rotary Club of Manila.

Archit was honored with the Presidential Tribute Award in recognition of his invaluable service, steadfast mentorship, and unwavering support to the Rotary Club of Manila. As Chairman of the Council of Past Presidents, he generously shared his wisdom, experience, and sound counsel with the Club’s leadership, serving as a respected adviser and a quiet yet influential guiding presence. His calm strength, discerning judgment, and loyal support have been instrumental in advancing the Club’s mission and preserving its enduring legacy. Through his exemplary dedication and faithful service, he earned the profound gratitude and highest esteem of the Rotary Club of Manila.

Boy was honored with the Presidential Tribute Award in recognition of his invaluable service, steadfast mentorship, and unwavering support to the Rotary Club of Manila. As a Past President, he generously shared his wisdom, experience, and sound counsel with the Club’s leadership, serving as a trusted mentor and a quiet yet influential guiding presence. His calm strength, discerning advice, and loyal support have contributed significantly to advancing the Club’s mission and safeguarding its enduring legacy. Through his exemplary dedication and faithful service, he earned the profound gratitude, sincere appreciation, and highest esteem of the Rotary Club of Manila.
Major Club Awards

The Rotary Club of Manila’s Major Awards represent the highest expressions of gratitude, recognition, and esteem that the Club bestows upon individuals whose dedication, leadership, generosity, and service have significantly advanced the Club’s mission and strengthened its enduring legacy.

These awards honor Rotarians, partners, and friends of the Club whose exemplary contributions have gone beyond duty and expectation — whether through outstanding leadership, faithful service, transformative projects, mentorship, philanthropy, or unwavering support of Rotary ideals. Their commitment to Service Above Self has enriched the lives of countless individuals, strengthened communities, and helped uphold the proud tradition of excellence that has distinguished the Rotary Club of Manila for more than a century.

Reggie rendered exemplary service to the Rotary Club of Manila through his outstanding contributions as Editor-in-Chief of The Balita, Member of the Board of Judges of the TOWER Awards, and President-Elect. Through his exceptional editorial leadership, discerning judgment, and commitment to excellence, he elevated The Balita as a meaningful platform for preserving the Club’s history, strengthening fellowship, and inspiring Rotarians. articles.title: Rotary Club of Manila Concludes Rotary Year with Meaningful 35th Weekly Membership Meeting

body.text: THE Rotary Club of Manila (RCM) gathered at the Manila Polo Club for its 35th Weekly Membership Meeting of Rotary Year 2025–2026, an afternoon marked by reflection, accountability, and inspiration. The meeting featured two highly anticipated presentations: the year-end report of the RCManila Foundation, Inc. (RCMFI) delivered by Chairman PDG Alexander P. Cureg, and the Classification Talk of Star Rotarian Manuel E. “AJ” Pangilinan, Chief Executive Officer of Finasiatech Corporation.

Presided over by Rotary Club of Manila President Raoul C. Creencia, the meeting brought together members, guests, and trustees to celebrate a year of accomplishments while looking toward new opportunities for service and leadership.
President Raoul Highlights Club Initiatives

In his message to the membership, President Raoul Creencia shared updates on key club initiatives and ongoing projects, including preparations for the forthcoming RCM Golf Cup and various service activities supported by the Rotary Club of Manila Foundation. The gathering also included presentations related to the club’s fundraising efforts, underscoring the importance of sustainable resource generation in advancing Rotary’s mission of service above self.

Trustee and Treasurer Michael Roxas presented the Foundation’s financial report, providing members with an overview of the organization’s fiscal position before the presentation of the Foundation’s comprehensive year-end accomplishments.
Special Report: PDG Alex Cureg Presents Transformative Year-End Report of the RCManila Foundation

The centerpiece of the meeting was the valedictory presentation of PDG Alexander P. Cureg, who reflected on a year defined by organizational reform, strengthened governance, financial stewardship, and impactful humanitarian service.
Building a Culture of Accountability and Transparency

PDG Cureg opened his report by expressing gratitude to the Board of Trustees for embracing a culture rooted in responsibility, accountabi lity, and transparency. He noted that when the Board assumed leadership, the Foundation faced significant administrative and operational challenges. Rather than allowing these issues to persist, the Board undertook a comprehensive effort to rebuild and strengthen the institution.

Through a series of reforms, the Foundation clarified its institutional identity as a resource-generating organization whose primary mission is to support the service projects of the Rotary Club of Manila. This distinction enabled the Foundation to align its governance structure, compliance requirements, and operational priorities more effectively.
The Board also streamlined personnel and administrative processes, improved office protocols, and instituted performance measures that restored discipline and accountability within the organization.
Modernizing Foundation Operations

One of the year’s notable accomplishments was the digitalization of Foundation records. By transitioning documents and institutional files into a centralized digital archive, the Foundation preserved its institutional memory and improved accessibility, efficiency, and continuity for future leaders.

Complementing this initiative was the adoption of a new Manual of Operations, which established clear governance standards and practical procedures for the organization. Designed to be both comprehensive and user-friendly, the manual provides a framework for sustaining good governance practices well into the future.
Strengthening Project Evaluation and Governance
Recognizing the importance of responsible stewardship, the Foundation implemented a more rigorous project evaluation and monitoring framework.

Under this system, all funding requests were subjected to objective scoring criteria, ensuring alignment with Foundation priorities, regulatory compliance, and measurable social impact. Enhanced reporting requirements were likewise introduced to guarantee transparency and accountability in the utilization of Foundation resources.
These reforms represented a significant step toward ensuring that every peso entrusted to the Foundation generates meaningful and measurable benefits for communities in need.
Financial Stewardship and Long-Term Sustainability
Financial discipline remained a cornerstone of the Foundation’s strategy throughout the year.

Among its major achievements was the successful renewal of the Foundation’s authority to issue tax deductible donation certificates, a development that strengthens its ability to attract philanthropic support. The Foundation also resolved long-standing compliance concerns and improved its accounting and financial reporting systems through enhanced internal controls and professionalized financial management practices.

To preserve and grow donor resources responsibly, the Foundation invested ₱5 million in a low-risk time deposit, generating additional income while safeguarding principal funds. This prudent approach reflects the Board’s commitment to balancing stability with sustainability.
The Legacy Endowment Fund Gains Momentum
A highlight of the Chairman’s report was the continued growth of the Legacy Endowment Fund, an initiative envisioned to secure the long-term financial future of the Foundation.

Supported by generous contributions from Rotarians, benefactors, and fundraising activities, the fund has already generated substantial support and continues to serve as a permanent financial pillar for future humanitarian initiatives.

PDG Cureg emphasized that the Legacy Endowment Fund represents more than a fundraising initiative—it is a commitment to ensuring that future generations of Rotarians will have the resources necessary to continue serving communities and responding to societal needs.
Humanitarian Projects Across the Nation
The Foundation’s humanitarian reach expanded significantly during the Rotary year, supporting projects across multiple sectors and communities.

Among the most impactful initiatives was a major cleft lip and palate surgical mission that transformed the lives of dozens of children and families. The Foundation also supported numerous disaster relief operations in communities affected by severe weather disturbances, providing emergency assistance, medicines, relief goods, and rehabilitation support.

Other funded projects included scholarship programs, literacy and teacher-training initiatives, medical outreach activities, animal welfare programs, and community development efforts implemented in partnership with Rotary clubs and civic organizations throughout the country.
Collectively, these projects demonstrated the Foundation’s commitment to addressing diverse social needs while remaining faithful to Rotary’s core values of service and compassion.
Growing Membership and Institutional Strength
The Foundation also experienced steady membership growth during the year, welcoming new members and strengthening its network of supporters.

PDG Cureg credited the accomplishments of the Foundation not to any single individual, but to the collective dedication of trustees, officers, members, volunteers, and benefactors who worked together to advance its mission.

As he concluded his report, he expressed confidence that the incoming leadership would continue the reforms and momentum established during the year, ensuring that the Foundation remains a strong and trusted vehicle for Rotary service.
Star Rotarian Manuel “AJ” Pangilinan Shares His Entrepreneurial Journey
The second major highlight of the afternoon was the Classification Talk delivered by Star Rotarian Manuel E. “AJ” Pangilinan, Chief Executive Officer of Finasiatech Corporation.

Introduced by Secretary Anton Mauricio, Pangilinan offered members a candid and engaging overview of his personal background, business ventures, and vision for the future of sustainable transportation in the Philippines.
Family Roots and Personal Background
Pangilinan began by thanking President Raoul Creencia and the members of the Rotary Club of Manila for welcoming him into the organization.

He shared insights into his family background, noting his connection to the well-known Pangilinan family and introducing members to the close-knit family environment that shaped his personal values and entrepreneurial mindset.
His presentation highlighted the importance of family, perseverance, and long-term relationships as guiding principles throughout his professional journey.
From Residential Real Estate to Strategic Office Development

Tracing the evolution of his business career, Pangilinan recounted how his real estate enterprise began in 2006 with a focus on residential development before expanding into commercial and retail projects.

Working with major retail operators and corporate clients, the company eventually shifted its focus toward office-space development and leasing through Mepangilinan Real Estate Brokerage Corporation (MREB Corp.).

Unlike traditional developers that generate income primarily from construction activities, Pangilinan’s model centers on long-term built-to suit office developments designed specifically for the needs of tenants. These projects are supported by multi-year lease agreements that provide predictable and sustainable revenue streams.

Today, the company has successfully completed thousands of square meters of office developments and maintains a substantial pipeline of future projects, serving prominent business process outsourcing and corporate clients.
Leadership in the BPO Industry
Beyond real estate, Pangilinan shared his active involvement in the business process outsourcing sector.

As an officer of the Contact Center industry’s SME Council, he works alongside companies ranging from emerging enterprises to some of the world’s largest technology and customer-service organizations.
He highlighted the sector’s tremendous contribution to the Philippine economy, noting its role as one of the country’s largest employers and a critical driver of economic growth.
His involvement in both real estate and the BPO sector has provided unique insights into workplace development, workforce needs, and the future of business infrastructure in the Philippines.
Driving the Future of Electric Mobility
Perhaps the most compelling aspect of Pangilinan’s presentation was his discussion of Finasiatech Corporation’s electric mobility initiatives.
Through the PickApp Mobility Ecosystem, the company is working to accelerate the transition from traditional fuel-powered transportation toward sustainable electric alternatives.

Rather than focusing on private automobiles, Finasiatech concentrates on the mass market, particularly tricycles and other community-based transport systems. The company collaborates directly with transport cooperatives and TODAs to provide accessible and practical electrification solutions.
A key innovation is its battery-leasing model, which significantly lowers the financial barriers for drivers by eliminating large upfront costs while ensuring long-term operational sustainability.
Pangilinan shared how the company has already expanded its operations into several cities and municipalities and continues to develop charging infrastructure and integrated transport solutions.

He also discussed efforts to connect electric buses, electric tricycles, and commuter transport systems into a seamless mobility ecosystem, helping address transportation challenges while promoting environmental sustainability.
Entrepreneurship with Purpose
Throughout his presentation, Pangilinan emphasized that successful entrepreneurship should create value not only for investors and clients but also for communities.

His ventures in office-space development help businesses grow and create employment opportunities, while his mobility initiatives seek to improve transportation, reduce emissions, and enhance the quality of life for ordinary Filipinos.

Members responded enthusiastically to his presentation, engaging him in a lively discussion during the open forum and gaining valuable insights into emerging opportunities in real estate, technology, and sustainable mobility.
A Fitting Conclusion to a Productive Rotary Year

The 35th Weekly Membership Meeting served as an appropriate culmination of Rotary Year 2025 2026. Through the RCManila Foundation’s impressive accomplishments under the leadership of PDG Alex Cureg and the inspiring entrepreneurial journey shared by Star Rotarian AJ Pangilinan, members were reminded that meaningful impact is achieved through sound stewardship, visionary leadership, and a steadfast commitment to service.

As the Rotary Club of Manila prepares to embark on a new Rotary year, the meeting reaffirmed the enduring strength of Asia’s First Rotary Club and the collective determination of its members to continue creating positive and lasting impact in the communities they serve.
Reginald T. Yu
Editor-in-Chief

AS Rotary Year 2025–2026 draws to a close, the final regular Weekly Membership Meeting of the Rotary Club of Manila carries a significance that transcends routine club business. It is a moment of reflection, gratitude, and recognition—a gathering where we look back not merely at what was accomplished, but at the spirit that animated those accomplishments.

At the heart of this occasion is the valedictory address of President Raoul C. Creencia, whose leadership has guided the club under the inspiring theme, “Our Destiny. Our Legacy. Rotary.” Those four words were more than a slogan. They became a call to action.

Destiny speaks of purpose. Legacy speaks of permanence. Rotary speaks of service. Together, they challenged every member to think beyond the immediate and embrace the enduring responsibility of stewardship. Throughout the year, President Raoul reminded us that the Rotary Club of Manila is not simply an organization we belong to; it is an institution we are privileged to inherit and duty bound to strengthen.

Leadership is often measured by projects completed, funds raised, memberships gained, or awards received. These are important metrics, and under President Raoul's stewardship, the club has much to celebrate. Yet the true measure of leadership lies elsewhere. It lies in the ability to inspire others to believe in a shared mission, to foster unity amidst differing views, and to ensure that the club remains stronger at the end of a term than it was at its beginning.
By that measure, President Raoul's year has been a success.

The annual bestowment of club awards serves as a reminder that Rotary's greatest achievements are never the work of one person alone. Every award presented represents countless hours of volunteer service, quiet acts of generosity, and an unwavering commitment to Service Above Self. It is fitting that these recognitions are bestowed during the final meeting of the Rotary year, for they affirm a fundamental truth: Rotary thrives because ordinary people choose to do extraordinary things for others.
Yet even as we honor the awardees, we must not overlook the example set by the man who led them.

President Raoul's service was marked by dedication that often went unseen. Behind every successful meeting, every completed project, every challenge resolved, and every difficult decision made was a leader who willingly carried the weight of responsibility. Rotary leadership is not glamorous. It demands patience, sacrifice, diplomacy, and countless hours that never appear in official reports. It requires placing the welfare of the club above personal convenience.
For this, the Rotary Club of Manila owes President Raoul a debt of gratitude.

We thank him for his indefatigable service. We thank him for the countless hours spent ensuring that the club remained focused on its mission. We thank him for his steady hand during moments of uncertainty and his unwavering belief in the capacity of Rotarians to rise to every challenge. Most importantly, we thank him for reminding us that our destiny is not something we inherit—it is something we create through our actions.

As one Rotary year concludes and another begins, we are reminded that leadership is temporary, but legacy endures. The projects will eventually be completed. The reports will be archived. The awards will be displayed. What remains are the values strengthened, the friendships forged, the lives touched, and the example left behind.
That is the essence of legacy.

President Raoul Creencia now joins the distinguished ranks of past presidents whose chapters have become part of the continuing story of Asia's First Rotary Club. His term will be remembered not only for what was accomplished, but for the spirit in which those accomplishments were pursued.
As Rotarians, we now inherit the responsibility to carry that legacy forward.
For in the end, our destiny is indeed our legacy.
And our legacy is Rotary.
President's Message

SINCE assuming the Presidency of Asia’s First Rotary Club, I have often felt as though I had taken on a second full-time calling alongside the exacting demands of my law practice. Yet I chose to embrace the journey—one meeting, one project, one fellowship activity, and one opportunity to serve at a time.

What unfolded was an extraordinary and deeply fulfilling year—one that stretched me, humbled me, and reminded me of the immense privilege of serving alongside accomplished men of uncommon generosity, talent, and purpose.

To lead a club such as Rotary Club of Manila is both a profound honor and a formidable responsibility. The role demands far more than presiding over meetings or representing the Club at official functions. It requires patience in moments of difficulty, resilience amid competing demands, and the steady resolve to inspire, unite, and mobilize a diverse fellowship of accomplished individuals behind causes far greater than ourselves.

Throughout the year, I learned that Rotary leadership is not about personal recognition. It is about listening, encouraging, building consensus, and creating opportunities for others to lead and shine. It is about bringing together the time, talent, resources, and goodwill of our members to transform worthy ideas into meaningful action.

It is also about leading by example -- doing what must be done, even when one must begin alone, so that others may be inspired to follow. Above all, it is about redefining leadership through friendship: nurturing trust, strengthening fellowship, and reminding one another that our greatest accomplishments are those we achieve together.

The demands were real: planning projects, mobilizing members, managing limited time and resources, and sustaining enthusiasm amid the many professional and personal commitments of fellow Manila Rotarians. But these challenges made every accomplishment more meaningful.

I take particular fulfillment in the flagship projects we were able to launch and advance during the year-- initiatives that reflected our Club’s continuing commitment to service, compassion, and lasting impact. To see our collective efforts translate into assistance for communities, opportunities for deserving students, support for peacebuilding advocates, and hope for those in need has been among the most rewarding experiences of my life.

I am likewise deeply grateful that our work has been recognized, with our Club being named among the Most Outstanding Rotary Clubs in the District, and with the honor bestowed upon me as among the Most Outstanding Rotary Club Presidents. These recognitions belong not to one person, but to every member, officer, committee chair, partner, and friend who gave generously of their time, talent, and resources throughout the year.

As we conclude this Rotary year, I do so with gratitude and a deep sense of fulfillment. We have demonstrated that when we work together with purpose, discipline, and fellowship, we can accomplish far more than any one of us could achieve alone.
This year has given deeper meaning to our motto:

Our Destiny.
Our Legacy.
Rotary.

Our destiny is not something we merely await; it is something we shape -- through every act of service we choose to undertake, every need we respond to, and every life we seek to uplift. Our legacy, in turn, will not be measured simply by the offices we held or the years we served, but by the lives we touched, the projects we sustained, and the values we entrusted to those who will carry Rotary forward after us.

The journey was not always easy. There were demands to meet, challenges to overcome, and moments when the weight of responsibility was deeply felt. Yet, through it all, the journey remained profoundly meaningful. It has been one of the most demanding, humbling, and fulfilling experiences of my life.

To have served this Club has been a privilege beyond measure. I leave this office with a heart full of gratitude: for the trust that everyone has given me, for the friendships shared, and for the opportunity to serve alongside fellow Rotarians whose commitment continues to inspire me.
As I now conclude this chapter, I do so with confidence that the best of our Club’s story is still being written.
This has been your Club President, your fellow Manila Rotarian -- now signing off, but forever committed to Rotary, to service, and to the enduring legacy we build together.
